transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here. What brings you in to see me today?

Lately, I keep having thoughts that my family would be better off if I weren’t here, and it’s starting to scare me. My wife and a close friend recently confronted me about how completely exhausted and withdrawn I've become, which is what finally pushed me to seek some help.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt the opposite of this—unusually energetic, full of ideas, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never felt that way at all. I’ve always been a pretty organized, routine-driven person, but never hyperactive or unusually energetic. It's always just been steady for me.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of feeling this down, exhausted, or withdrawn in the past, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

No, this is the very first time I've ever felt this way. I've never experienced anything like this before, and these heavy feelings of exhaustion and being withdrawn only started and have been building up since my father's stroke about a year and a half ago.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling this down, exhausted, and withdrawn nearly every day, for most of the day?

Yes, it is pretty much every single day, all day long. It feels like a constant, heavy weight that never really lifts, and it has just been steadily building ever since my dad's stroke a year and a half ago.
Have you found yourself losing interest or pleasure in the activities and hobbies you used to enjoy?

Yes, completely. I used to love woodworking, strength-training, and going out on the lake with my fishing club, but I've lost all interest in doing any of it now. On the rare evenings I actually have free time, I just sit on the couch staring at the TV, unable to bring myself to pick up a tool or reach out to anyone.
How has your sleep been during this time? Are you having trouble falling or staying asleep, or are you finding yourself sleeping much more than usual?

It's been awful. I lie awake for hours replaying the day and worrying about my dad or work, and then I wake up multiple times and am up for good around four in the morning. Even though I'm completely exhausted, I feel like I never actually sleep.
Along with these feelings, have you been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness, or have you been blaming yourself excessively for things?

Yes, I feel like a complete failure as a son, a husband, and a manager. I constantly replay mistakes in my head—like missing my dad's medication times, snapping at a worker, or forgetting my kid's school event. It just feels like constant proof that everyone in my life would be much better off with someone more capable than me.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making decisions lately, especially at work or at home?

My mind feels foggy all the time now, and I struggle to do simple things like following blueprints or making decisions about hiring subcontractors at work. I've even started losing track of my dad's medical appointments, and I'm constantly second-guessing myself because everything takes me forever to figure out.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as eating much less or more than usual?

Yes, I have. Most days I have to remind myself to eat because absolutely nothing sounds appealing to me anymore. My wife keeps pointing out how my pants are hanging off me, even though I'm not trying to lose weight.
Have you or your family noticed if you are speaking or moving much more slowly than usual, or on the other hand, do you feel physically restless and unable to sit still?
I'm not really sure if I'm moving or speaking slower, or if I feel restless. I haven't really thought about it that way, to be honest.
To help me understand the full picture, do you have any medical conditions, or are you currently taking any medications or using alcohol or other substances?
No, I don't have any major medical conditions and I'm not taking any prescription medications. I also don't really drink alcohol or use any other substances.
